notes.title: Second dragon game
notes.notes:
[h1][b]The 2nd game[/b] about dragons[/h1]
The 2nd game about dragons from the Elmarion series: [b]"Elmarion: Dragon's Princess"[/b] is coming soon.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35777797/27b6122661e45370b91ae072719f468a67c1b7bf.jpg[/img]
[b]The game page: [u]https://store.steampowered.com/app/1468040/Elmarion_Dragons_Princess/[/u][/b]
The plot of the game continues the 1st game of the series.
The game is scheduled for release very soon: [b]December 14th.[/b]

[h2]Description[/h2]
Elmarion: Dragon's Princess is an RPG game about a dragon who befriends a princess. In this game, we again have to play as a dragon: fly around the 3D world of Elmarion, burn entire armies of enemies, and complete missions.
The main mechanics (dragons, skills, items) are inherited from Elmarion: Dragon time.

[h2]Differences from “Elmarion: Dragon time”[/h2]
1. The dragon now has a companion in the game - a princess, who has some useful abilities and can really help. The princess sometimes flies on a dragon.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35777797/b1eaedf399562b644ff29428309aba1447c3f41a.jpg[/img]
2. 10 new locations - 10 missions.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35777797/c349d1becc1cee20158471257c1c51b346c77264.jpg[/img]
3. New skills for all dragons (although the models and textures are the same, many skills have been replaced with new ones).
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35777797/3c3172a21ef42ddc1d70cfd165a562d587322bd3.jpg[/img]
4. The dragon is 3 times bigger than in the first game! So now people are really small compared to the dragon.
5. New mechanic: you can crush heaps of people, just by landing on them
6. The dragon is initially stronger than its counterpart from the 1st part (again, because it has become larger)
7. Missions are carried out sequentially: one after another. This has its advantages: the player cannot "get lost" in the game, as it happened in the 1st game. In addition, you can always choose the mission to play (as in the Warcraft3 campaign).

[b]Add to the wishlist: [u]https://store.steampowered.com/app/1468040/Elmarion_Dragons_Princess/[/u][/b]

notes.title: Electric Dragon
notes.notes:
Update!
Electric Dragon
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35777797/b0593c13a45697e1e834149b1a511f9925595d10.jpg[/img]
The Electric Dragon is a dragon capable of slaying enemies with swift lightning. It surpasses other dragons in attack speed, but it doesn't have much health.
The skills of the Electric dragon:
1. Electric charge. Launches a small but very fast electrical charge that strikes a single target.
2. Electric guard. Creates a small electric beam that hangs motionless in the air and shoots electrical charges at all nearby enemies within a certain radius
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35777797/9e019248d11c603edf287ba9941e43496982ec45.jpg[/img]
3. Lightning. Emits lightning
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35777797/6f733c29d604b05634bcae0128215a3731ccf20b.jpg[/img]
4. Electrical charges. Drops 25% of health from all enemies nearby within a certain radius.
5. Thunderclap. Calls down a powerful point strike from the sky, dealing a lot of damage to a single target.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35777797/75a63920de919278888677d0fc44c3a77d572bbe.jpg[/img]
6. Touch of lightning. Deals damage and also paralyzes the target for several seconds.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35777797/b880b7741030e1adc92b7c0693dbacf4f0279d29.jpg[/img]
7. Astral. The dragon goes into the astral state. In this state, it cannot be attacked by enemies. But it cannot attack anyone.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35777797/1d104260bb192de39897467301d1942bd6eae6bc.jpg[/img]
8. Lightning speed. Increases the dragon's attack speed for a while.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35777797/2fdf603efcfc608373357f628470b162a56c2698.jpg[/img]
9. Electric wings. Increases the dragon's movement speed for a while.
10. Electric field. Creates an electrified sphere around itself, which deals minor damage to all creatures around the dragon and charges this energy (mana) of the dragon itself.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35777797/62a449eaa23976020fd2c4913480ea59975c0f0c.jpg[/img]

The main gameplay trailer has been updated on the game page.
Also, 4 new languages have been added to the game: Japanese, Korean, Italian and Turkish.
Today a 40% discount on the game is announced!

notes.title: Green Dragon
notes.notes:
Update!
Green Dragon
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35777797/4add162c751c45fb5342ffcb1e3d962dc05a73c1.jpg[/img]
A new dragon has been added to the game. It differs from the Fire Dragon and Ice Dragon.
The Green dragon is the dragon of nature, of life. This dragon is neither strong nor fast, it does not like to fight. But it has faithful helpers - the forces of nature, who will always come to its aid. 
The main skills of the Green dragon:
1. Lifestrike. The green bolt deals not big damage to a single enemy target, but it heals friendly units.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35777797/92ab6ecdabd27392c4de0c876dd8fb440d2307c9.jpg[/img]
2. Touch of nature. Deals some damage to enemies, while restoring the dragon's health and energy.
3. Ent. Summons the ent-defender. The Ent defender has good health and armor, however, it only fights in melee combat.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35777797/c84e3dbe9990439d533d40e432a7794657bba9c1.jpg[/img]
4. Ent-mage. Summons an ent-mage. The ent mage uses earth magic by firing small magical projectiles at enemies from a distance.
5. Lifebreath. The dragon emits a green flame that hits enemies and heals friends at a short distance.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35777797/67ad4c2111b18b1fdde57595551ec25f3d9913f5.jpg[/img]
6. Flying golem. Summons a powerful spirit of nature - a flying golem for help. It is fast, tough, and able to help out well in battle.
Additional dragon skills:
1. Heal. Heals the dragon and its friends at a short distance.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35777797/b9559069b6eb243b6fc4d7fd82b3fc1e2e07883b.jpg[/img]
2. Life armor. Increases armor and resistance to the dragon and its friends.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35777797/995788d974027d70e521f76af28bb8754e7dcbe7.jpg[/img]
3. Regeneration aura. Speeds up the health regeneration of the dragon and its friends.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35777797/b4ef1a6453e9921c96a3ed69f4f72b43c813ed10.jpg[/img]
4. Power of nature. Increases the attack power of the dragon and its friends.

This update also includes the following:
1. French localization is added.
2. English localization errors are fixed.
3. Dragon models and textures have been updated. The dragons are increased in size.
4. The physics of objects is changed. The dragon can now push enemies away rather than stumbling over them. After all, it is much heavier and larger than them!
5. Dragon control is improved. Now he ran better, stumbled less.
6. New sounds for the dragon (flapping wings, walking sounds) are added.
7. New ambient sounds are added.

notes.title: New update! Ice Dragon.
notes.notes:
Update!
Ice Dragon
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35777797/1a5bf4e1d4bdc11942aa90e566953a51ed6647fe.jpg[/img]
A new dragon has been added to the game. It differs from the Fire Dragon in both characteristics and skills.
The main characteristic of the Ice Dragon is intellect (energy). The growth of this parameter for the ice dragon is +4, while for the fire dragon - +2. However, the ice dragon has less health and strength than the fire dragon.
The fighting skills of the ice dragon:
1. Ice strike. An analogue of the fire strike of the fire dragon. Unlike a fire bolt, it does not have a splash, but it freezes (slows down) the enemy for a few seconds.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35777797/8c8829dedad4681d072cd6d8c7b16fe342c24e21.jpg[/img]
2. Ice touch. An analogue of a fire bite. Deals good melee damage to the selected target. It freezes both attack and movement very strongly for a few seconds. Replenishes energy (mana).
3. Iceball. Unlike a fireball, it falls physically large and heavy, so it does not fly far, but falls on a balloon. Therefore, it can be used as a bombing means. When hit on a hard surface or on an enemy, the ball breaks and deals powerful splash damage in a small radius.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35777797/bcbf6adbd6f8c9dc0edfc83f6d7bf57b7615d9cf.jpg[/img]
4. Icebreath. Analogous to the firebreath of a fire dragon.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35777797/82cff485e2aeb057a68e7cfa1049df52584c2fbb.jpg[/img]
5. Ice nova. The dragon releases a ring of ice around it, dealing very serious damage to everyone in the ring's radius.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35777797/b6a7f3e52e0e0d9765a3dd42e4a5bf045d349dc2.jpg[/img]
6. Ice flow. The dragon fires a powerful stream of ice shards with high damage. The icy stream flies in a long and wide trajectory, damaging everyone in the area.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35777797/3e0d03baa73d015684b3c6cb59ba84a8086cf80a.jpg[/img]
Additional dragon skills:
1. Ice shield. Half of the damage taken (both physical and magical) is absorbed by energy instead of health (analogous to the "mana shield" in Diablo)
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35777797/0c4a39c77f0de3c079ab75a0dee5b9026756cb2a.jpg[/img]
2. Ice Energy. The dragon's speed and energy parameters are temporarily increased.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35777797/b6a7f3e52e0e0d9765a3dd42e4a5bf045d349dc2.jpg[/img]
3. Ice aura. Slows down by 50% and damages all enemies in a radius around the dragon.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35777797/7e42dfecf298878688416628f6bf5896f6adaffb.jpg[/img]
4. Ice King. Temporarily greatly increases health and energy based on dragon level
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35777797/01571a94eb1f674d0f7d778ec342f31bdea9ce33.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Big update! Equipment and dungeons!
notes.notes:
Very big update!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35777797/bc1f4d6defcc4ec630d20f7e254e51bc3583f10a.jpg[/img]

What's new?
1. Inventory and equipment system. Now there are items that you can (and should) put on a dragon! There are two types of things in the game now: ordinary and unique. Ordinary things are written in white and generate random parameters depending on the level of the item. Unique items have constant parameters, are written in green and have a unique picture. Unnecessary items can be sold to merchant in Aalon or Arial for crystals.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35777797/af39a96ad072586e3d1490e5da44b9b9606f732b.jpg[/img]

2. Four new dungeon type locations are added! (The starting cave is changed). 2 new monsters are added for these locations. Shining treasure is added at some caves. Dragon love treasures, don't they? :) 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35777797/ff402a0424d75504753434eace42a4b7e6bbf190.jpg[/img]

3. The combat system and balance of skills are changed. Dragon flight is without dropping the mouse by default. The first fireball became much faster and gained an increase in the radius of attack: it will be much easier to shoot archers from the sky now! The second fireball (heavy, slow) began to do much more damage than the first. Melee attack is improved. The firebreath is weakened.

4. New parameters are added and the balance of old parameters is changed. Damage, health and mana progress has been reduced. The Speed parameter now affects an attack speed. The Luck parameter affects the chance of finding items and the quality of items dropped. Resistances to the elements are added (can only be increased with the help of items).

5. Navigation for units is improved: now they do not pass through walls and houses.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35777797/34cc57c8ea8bb632e9418d9ee75ca7818354b4ff.jpg[/img]
